explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. `IsNullSet` is the library's own definition of chartwise null sets on a manifold: a set is null when its image in every extended chart has measure zero for every Haar measure on the model. I searched Mathlib's `Geometry` directory for `IsNullSet` and `MeasureZero`/`measureZero` and found nothing. I also searched all of Mathlib for the chart-image pattern `extChartAt I x '' (s ∩`, with no matches either, so Mathlib has no equivalent notion. The proof unfolds the definition and applies the generic lemma `measure_mono_null` together with `image_mono`. Those lemmas only supply the generic monotonicity step; what makes this theorem true is the library's own definition, so it does not duplicate Mathlib.
